about: Raw inputs of the real-terrain SUAS 2026 field world (Skyway36, Tulsa OK). Downloaded and verified by sim_worlds/scripts/fetch_real_field_data.sh into $ASTRA_WORLD_DATA (default ~/.astra_sim/world_data)/suas_field_real/raw/<file>. Raw data is never committed to git.
